title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
before: Open weights trailed the closed frontier by a clear margin.
problem: Nobody had released a model that could stand beside GPT-4 class systems.
breakthrough: 405B parameters, 128K context, a candid 90-page account of the training, and a licence permitting distillation from outputs.
why: Open weights reached the frontier, and the distillation clause seeded a generation of smaller models.
next: Llama 4's MoE in 2025, then Meta's pivot to closed models in 2026.
inherits: The expectation that open weights compete at the frontier, now contested.
